subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
THE IMAGE-WIDE DEMAND CENSUS claim.WR_constant-equality-closure-class-proposal.20260903.v1 asked the integrator to require before commissioning anything. That proposal measured four named functions plus two controls and said so verbatim: 'NOT SCREENED IMAGE-WIDE: this census is the four functions the run-42 order named plus two controls, not a sweep; the true population is unmeasured'. This is the sweep. Measured at 9eb99ec5c on a full green build (ninja prints build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK) with tools/gdl/composed_census/ce_const_closure_census.py, which composes the shipped guards and re-implements nothing: every copy-form edit it applies was accepted by webfrank.equivalent_copy_form itself, and both proof columns run the run-42 prototype driver tools/gdl/composed_census/wr_const_closure_probe.py.

METHOD, and the two calibration defects the first two passes carried. Population: 2842 paired equal-size functions, 288 whose raw body differs from the target. 188 carry a structurally differing word and are out of scope for any relational widening. The remaining 100 are staged raw body -> auto-derived equivalent_copy_form edits -> copy_register_fields, and every one reaches the target bytes under that staging (91 need no form edit, 9 need 1-2). Three columns are then run over the same pair of images: verify_consistent_recolor (STRICT), the shipped value-equality relation, and that relation seeded with constant equality.

DEFECT 1, FORM-SITE DETECTION. wf_census.classify labels a word `regfield` whenever the two encodings differ only in register fields, and `addi rD,rS,0` against `li rD',K` satisfies that (both are opcode 14 with immediate 0). A form-site detector keyed on that label therefore never offers the copy-versus-constant site to equivalent_copy_form. The first pass of this census did exactly that, scored scroll_credits as needing no form edit, and watched it refuse with `+0xe4: base register presence differs (g25 vs g0)` - i.e. it MISSED THE PROPOSAL'S OWN PAYOFF ROW. Form sites must be detected by DECODED COPY FORM (decode_copy_form on both words, kinds differing), never by the encoding-level regfield label. Recorded separately as claim.law.CE_a-copy-versus-constant-site-encodes-as-a-pure-register-field-difference.20260903.v1.

DEFECT 2, THE MISSING STRICT COLUMN. apply_patch tries verify_consistent_recolor FIRST and reaches the wider modes only when it refuses, so a function the strict proof already serves is a customer for nothing however the wider columns score it. Without that column the second pass reported 5 payoff rows; 79 of the 100 screened functions are strict-served and 21 are open.

THE PAYOFF TABLE. Five rows are strict-REFUSED, shipped-value-equality-REFUSED and closure-PROVED with byte-equality. THREE OF THE FIVE ARE STAGING ARTIFACTS, not demand: game/world/tower::TowerCheckMessages (pin = copy_register_fields + instruction_permutation), game/game/gamemain::fn_80054E78 (copy_register_fields + equivalent_copy_form) and game/sfx/psfx::LoadPdataFile (copy_register_fields + equivalent_copy_form + instruction_permutation) are each verified by the build over a DIFFERENT intermediate image than this census stages, their rules declare neither value_equality_recolor nor unproven_recolor_audit, and apply_patch has no third acceptance path - so the build already proves all three today and a refusal in this census's columns says nothing about them. Counting them would have overstated the class five-fold.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY THERE, TWO FUNCTIONS. (1) SCORE PAYOFF = 1: game/ui/attract::scroll_credits, 148 insns, unpinned, tier 2 (2 auto-derived form edits), closure PROVED with 6 substitutions / 0 exchanges / byte-equal True. This reproduces the proposal's own premise_measurement EXACTLY (6 substitutions, byte-equal True) and is the calibration that the census's shipped-mode column is not a re-implementation with different behaviour. A rule here is +1 EQUIVALENT function. (2) SOUNDNESS PAYOFF = 1, and it is the larger one for a soundness run: game/enemy/critter::CritterResolveMultipleTargets, 111 insns, is served TODAY by `copy_register_fields` + `unproven_recolor_audit` - an UNPROVEN pin, accepted by a human audit note dated 2026-08-24 - and its rule carries no permutation and no form stage, so this census's staging IS the build's staging for it. The closure PROVES it with 4 substitutions, 0 exchanges, byte-equal. The closure would convert an unproven pin into a machine-proved one.

THE UNPROVEN-PIN CROSS-TAB. Six of the seven `unproven_recolor_audit` rules image-wide are reachable by this census. The closure RETIRES exactly one (CritterResolveMultipleTargets). Five stand and each names its own obstruction: game/enemy/enemy::move_logic00 (+0x220 f29 vs f30), game/ps2/fakelib::sceRead (+0x118 g27 vs g29), game/world/btricol::PointLineDist2D (+0x30 f0 vs f1), game/audio/mempool::pool_garbage_collect (+0x30 g0 vs g0), game/pb/pb_texture::fn_800C72DC (+0x9c g7 vs g28).

CONTROLS HELD. 4 functions are already served by the shipped value-equality mode and the closure changes NEITHER their verdict NOR their declaration counts (0 of 4 changed), so the widening does not silently alter a rule that already proves. 12 rows are refused by both wider columns and are the residue any further widening would face; game/sys/memcard::drawMemCardMessage is among them, refusing at +0x1ec exactly as attempt.WR_drawmemcardmessage-constant-closure-serves-the-filed-row-but-a-second-obstruction-stands.20260903.v1 measured.

VERDICT FOR THE INTEGRATOR. The census does not refute the proposal - the payoff set is not empty, which is the failure mode claim.law.WF_same-register-both-sides-capability-has-an-empty-payoff-set.20260901.v1 names - but it is SMALL and precisely bounded: one new EQUIVALENT function and one unproven-pin retirement, against a mode that must be written, tested, and guarded forever. The soundness half is the stronger argument and the score half is nearly negligible. Nothing was built: this record and the table under build/GUNE5D/ce_const_closure_census.json are the deliverable, and the class decision remains the integrator's per the Mandatory result policy.
